name: Cursor Origin
desc: Code hosting inside Cursor with repositories and pull requests built for agents.
desc_zh: Cursor 内置的代码托管，仓库和 Pull Request 都按智能体规模设计。
solves: Hosting designed for human review slows agent work; repositories, pull requests and code browsing live next to the agents that write them.
solves_zh: 为人工审查设计的托管会拖慢智能体的节奏；仓库、Pull Request 和代码浏览就放在写代码的智能体旁边。
best_for: Your agents open dozens of pull requests a day and GitHub review queues are the bottleneck.
best_for_zh: 智能体每天开几十个 Pull Request，瓶颈在 GitHub 的审查队列。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 Early beta on all paid plans. An Origin App Marketplace followed on 2026-10-16. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Origin」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/origin-code-hosting
